clips.title: The story
paras: Auberdine is the bustling coastal port town of Darkshore, serving as the primary maritime link between Kalimdor's northern forests and the outside world. The settlement stands whole and vital under the stewardship of the night elves.

In Darkshore, Auberdine stands as the central haven for travelers, druids, and sentinels safeguarding northern Kalimdor. Its docks provide steady passage across the waters to Rut'theran Village at the base of Teldrassil and south to the wetlands of the Eastern Kingdoms. The town's moonwell provides spiritual solace to all who venerate Elune, and its craftsmen supply travelers braving the haunted shoreline.
